section_summary: This section contains documentation relating to the implementation of postwar Japanese agrarian land reform, comprising legislative texts, executive ordinances, diplomatic reporting, and interdepartmental correspondence from late 1946 and early 1947. It includes the concluding articles of the Special Measure for the Establishment of Owner-Farmers, imperial ordinances establishing its enforcement regulations and effective date, and the opening provisions and errata of the Agricultural Land Adjustment Law. In addition, the section features State Department correspondence proposing an agricultural mission to assist SCAP with land reform supervision, as well as an airgram reporting British parliamentary discussion on the reform program.

subfiles.about: English translation of Articles 23 through 51 and supplementary provisions of the Special Measure for the Establishment of Owner-Farmers governing land transfers, payments, and administrative commissions.
keywords: Special Measure for the Establishment of Owner-Farmers
subfiles.summary: This concluding section of the Special Measure for the Establishment of Owner-Farmers (Articles 23–51 and Supplementary Provisions) sets forth procedures for creating owner-cultivated farmland in postwar Japan. It governs the exchange and resale of state-acquired lands, repayment through 30-year annual installments, and the compulsory purchase and development of uncultivated lands and associated rights. The statute defines the administrative authority of local, prefectural, and national land commissions, establishes penal provisions, and mandates retroactive application to land tenancy conditions as of November 23, 1945.
subfiles.title: Special Measure for the Establishment of Owner-Farmers

subfiles.summary: Ernest A. Gross recommends sending an agricultural specialist mission to SCAP to supervise Japanese land reform under the War Department's reorientation program.
subfiles.title: Letter from Ernest A. Gross to Major General Daniel Noce

subfiles.about: English translation from Kanpo of Imperial Ordinances Nos. 620 and 621 establishing the effective date and enforcement regulations for owner-farmer land reform.
keywords: Special Measure for the Establishment of Owner-Farmers
subfiles.summary: Promulgated in Kanpo No. 5988, Imperial Ordinance No. 620 designates December 29, 1946, as the effective date for the Special Measure for the Establishment of Owner-Farmers. Imperial Ordinance No. 621 establishes comprehensive enforcement regulations, defining exceptions to owner-cultivation requirements, land purchase and valuation criteria, and resale terms to tenant farmers. It assigns specific duties to municipal, prefectural, and central land boards, mandates the completion of land acquisitions by late 1948, and amends related fisheries and land adjustment ordinances.
subfiles.title: Imperial Ordinance No. 620 and Imperial Ordinance No. 621 (Order to Carry Out the Special Measure for the Establishment of Owner-Farmers)

subfiles.about: English translation and errata sheet for Articles 1 through 15-2 of the Agricultural Land Adjustment Law regulating farmland tenure, rent controls, and conciliation.
subfiles.from: Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, Agricultural Administration Bureau, Farmland Section
subfiles.summary: This translation, incorporating an errata table issued by the Farmland Section of the Agricultural Administration Bureau, covers Articles 1 through 15-2 of the Agricultural Land Adjustment Law. The legislation aims to stabilize cultivator status and maintain agricultural productivity by regulating the transfer and use of farmland. It prohibits unauthorized conveyance, bans tenancy rent in kind while capping cash rents, protects leaseholders against arbitrary eviction, and establishes court conciliation mechanisms alongside local Agricultural Land Commissions.
subfiles.title: Agricultural Land Adjustment Law (with Errata)
